clauses.text: The Supplier shall maintain Monthly Availability of at least 99.9%, calculated in accordance with Clause 2.
Monthly Availability means the percentage of minutes during a calendar month when the Service is accessible, excluding Scheduled Maintenance up to four hours per month.

If Monthly Availability is below 99.9%, the Customer may claim a service credit of 5% of the monthly subscription fee, provided that the Customer submits a written claim within 30 days after month-end.
The Supplier shall not disclose Customer Data to third parties except to subprocessors listed in Schedule A, unless the Customer has given prior written consent.
Any service credit exceeding EUR 100 shall require prior written approval from the Finance Director before issuance.
